_comment: Basic parts: things wired straight to one GPIO and declared as `pin name: Mode = N`. Devices with drivers come from device.json. {gpio} and {name} are filled in by the IDE.

parts.label: LED / relay
parts.name: led
parts.keywords: light lamp relay output digital on off buzzer active
wiring: GPIO {gpio} → 220–330 Ω resistor → LED long leg (+)
Relay: use a relay module — IN → GPIO {gpio}, VCC → 5V, GND → GND
The switched load goes on the module's COM / NO screws, never on the board
A loud or 5V buzzer needs a transistor between the pin and the buzzer
GPIO {gpio} → MOSFET / transistor or driver input — never the load directly
Give the load its own supply and share GND with the board
Motors, pumps and solenoids need a flyback diode across them
GPIO {gpio} → 220–330 Ω resistor → LED long leg (+)

parts.label: Button / switch
parts.name: button
parts.keywords: push switch key input pullup tactile reed door
wiring: No resistor needed — the chip has one built in

parts.label: Dimmer / motor
parts.name: motor
parts.keywords: pwm fade dim fan motor speed brightness buzzer tone
wiring: LED: GPIO {gpio} → 220 Ω → LED (+), LED (–) → GND
Motor / fan: GPIO {gpio} → motor driver or MOSFET input — never the motor directly
A loud buzzer or small speaker needs a transistor between the pin and it
GPIO {gpio} → motor driver or MOSFET input — never the motor directly
Give the motor its own supply and share GND with the board
A bare MOSFET needs a flyback diode across the motor
GPIO {gpio} → 220 Ω resistor → LED long leg (+)

parts.label: Servo
parts.name: servo
wiring: More than one servo? Give them their own 5V supply (share GND)

parts.label: Knob / analog sensor
parts.name: sensor
parts.keywords: potentiometer knob analog adc ldr photoresistor soil moisture

parts.label: Digital sensor
parts.name: signal
parts.keywords: pir motion sound ir obstacle digital input module
wiring: VCC → 3V3 (or 5V if the module needs it)

parts.label: Touch pad
parts.name: touch
wiring: GPIO {gpio} → a metal pad, foil or wire end

parts.label: Button to 3V3
parts.name: button
wiring: No resistor needed — the chip has one built in
